Part 3 - Read The Letter

Questions 8-10
Read the letter. Then answer the questions.

Hi, Grandpa. How are you? I hope you are well. My parents are doing fine and my little sister is also doing well. I am very excited because my summer vacation starts next Friday. Mom told me that I can visit you during the vacation. Let's go fishing together. It was so much fun when we went camping and caught some fish last summer.

See you soon!

Sincerely,
Raymond
